rollback.method: This package only touches its own allowed files and is file-disjoint from Package A. To roll back: `git revert <commit>...` for each of the six commits (reverse order), or `git checkout 542d042 -- <allowed files>` after dropping the six commits. The release checker and CI never mutate state.
rollback.verifyAfterRollback: npm test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
